first.rationale: Competitive entry pricing creates an immediate, segment-specific acquisition risk among price-sensitive SMBs, and prior evidence supports targeted pricing there. Because activation and onboarding are also declining, verify both the prior pricing lift and onboarding evidence before committing; if pricing proceeds, constrain it to a guarded SMB offer with qualification and downstream retention/revenue checks.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying and shortening self-serve onboarding. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline, while verified evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline, undermining sustainable qualified revenue.
